name: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
description: Will, a street-smart teenager, moves from the tough streets of West Philly to posh Bel-Air to live with his Uncle Philip, Aunt Vivian, his cousins — spoiled Hilary, preppy Carlton and young Ashley — and their sophisticated British butler, Geoffrey. Though Will’s antics and upbringing contrast greatly with the upper-class lifestyle of his extended relatives, he soon finds himself right at home as a loved part of the family.

videos.title: Back To Bel-Air: A Fresh Look
videos.overview: A retrospective documentary. Season 01 DVD extra;  A Fresh Look with the Stars and Creative Team.

videos.title: The Best Bits of Bel-Air
videos.overview: A compilation of the best bits and recurring gags from the 'Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. Included with Season 2 of the series on the DVD release.

videos.title: Bel-Air Bloopers - Season 2 DVD
videos.overview: Bloopers from 'The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air'. Included with the Season 2 DVD release.

videos.title: Best Of The Upper Bel-Air Crust
videos.overview: Trivia and Behind the Scenes facts on "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air". Included on the Season 3 DVD release.

videos.title: Bel-Air Bloopers - Season 3 DVD
videos.overview: Bloopers from 'The Fresh Prince of Be-Air'. Included on the Season 3 DVD release.

videos.title: Will From Home - The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Reunion
videos.overview: The "Will From Home" reunion, part of Will Smith's Snapchat show, featured the main cast reminiscing, sharing memories, and paying tribute to the late James Avery, who played Uncle Phil.

videos.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Reunion
videos.overview: 30 years later, we're bringing the Banks family back together. Join Will Smith and his former co-stars for a funny and heartfelt night full of music and dancing in honor of the show that ran for six seasons and 148 episodes.

videos.title: The Fresh Prince Project
videos.overview: Aunt Vivian tries to mediate between her husband Philip and the newly arrived Will.

videos.title: Bang the Drum, Ashley
videos.overview: Will persuades Ashley to pawn her violin for a drum set.

videos.title: Clubba Hubba
videos.overview: Will wants to go out with a beautiful girl he meets at the country club, but first he must figure out how to impress her extremely snobbish and very protective father so he seeks tips from cousin Carlton on becoming preppie.

videos.title: Not with My Pig, You Don't
videos.overview: Will tries to smooth things between Philip and his very rural parents when they visit to see him receive an award.

videos.title: Homeboy, Sweet Homeboy
videos.overview: Will gets a visit from an old pal named Ice Tray, who, to Vivian and Philip's dismay, warms up to Hilary.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Jailed, Will and Carlton stage a media stunt.

videos.title: Def Poet's Society
videos.overview: Will joins his prep school's poetry club.

videos.title: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (1)
videos.overview: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

videos.title: Someday Your Prince Will Be in Effect (2)
videos.overview: Carlton and Will, babe magnets. Who will be first to get a date for Hilary's Halloween party?

videos.title: Kiss My Butler
videos.overview: Happy birthday Geoffrey! For a gift, Will tries matchmaking, then falls for Geoffrey's date himself.

videos.title: Courting Disaster
videos.overview: Carlton feels overshadowed by Will, who's become a basketball star at school.

videos.title: Talking Turkey
videos.overview: A holiday visit from Will's taskmaster mother puts the kibosh on conspicuous consumption and puts the kids to work preparing Thanksgiving dinner.

videos.title: Knowledge is Power
videos.overview: Hilary becomes Will's personal maid when he threatens to disclose she's dropped out of UCLA.

videos.title: Day Damn One
videos.overview: Will tells Ashley's slumber party guests a scary tale about his first day at Bel-Air Academy.

videos.title: Deck the Halls
videos.overview: Will inimitably dresses the mansion for the holidays, to the dismay of the neighbors, including heavyweight boxing champion Evander Holyfield.

videos.title: The Lucky Charm
videos.overview: Philip may lose a superstitious client whom he advises not to make decisions based on Will's spontaneous remarks.

videos.title: The Ethnic Tip
videos.overview: Will proposes a black history class be instituted at Bel-Air Academy, and gets a surprise when Aunt Viv arrives to teach it.

videos.title: The Young and the Restless
videos.overview: Will sneaks Philip's elderly mother out of the house for a night on the town.

videos.title: It Had to Be You
videos.overview: Will has girl problems after a date with Jazz's domineering sister, who's ready to pick out a china pattern before the night is over.

videos.title: Nice Lady
videos.overview: Fresh Prince Will is on his best behavior for visiting royalty - the seemingly demure Lady Penelope, who Will hopes to persuade to let herself have a good time at a party.

videos.title: Love at First Fight
videos.overview: Jasmine Guy plays a scholarship student whose introduction to Will opens up a different world of fun and games - and romance - to divert her from her studies.

videos.title: Banks Shot
videos.overview: Will crawls to Philip for help after sneaking out on the town and getting hustled by sleazy pool sharks.

videos.title: 72 Hours
videos.overview: Will challenges Carlton to spend time in a tough neighborhood, trying to survive by masquerading as a financial consultant.

videos.title: Just Infatuation
videos.overview: R&B singer Tevin Campbell plays teen idol Little T, who surprises Ashley on her birthday with a special song and an invitation for a date.

videos.title: Working It Out
videos.overview: Rap's Queen Latifah plays Hilary's new actress boss, who wants Will as her boy toy - or Hilary's glamorous job is over.

videos.title: Did the Earth Move for You?
videos.overview: Will's all-consuming romance with a new girlfriend shakes up the Banks' household, as does Mother Nature, trapping them together during an earthquake.

videos.title: The Mother of All Battles
videos.overview: Will and Carlton arrive as reinforcements when a bully challenges Ashley to a rumble, but there's real trouble when Philip and Vivian intervene.

videos.title: Will Gets a Job
videos.overview: Will tries to juggle school and a new job in order to earn money for the homecoming party, at the same time Ashley's classmate Tina becomes interested in Carlton. Will starts becoming paranoid when he constantly is getting confused with Carlton.

videos.title: PSAT Pstory
videos.overview: Will is a picture of confidence, while Carlton is a frazzled bundle of nerves preparing for college aptitude tests.

videos.title: Granny Gets Busy
videos.overview: Mortified over spying his mother kiss the handyman, Philip can't bear to think of her having a new man in her life.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Marry?
videos.overview: Tensions spill over just before the wedding of Will's Aunt Janice when Will's mom meets Janice's intended - and forbids Will to attend the interracial wedding.

videos.title: The Big Four-Oh
videos.overview: Vivian's 40th birthday marks a crisis and a career change in which she plans to perfect her dance skills.

videos.title: She Ain't Heavy
videos.overview: Will hits it off with the full-figured Dee Dee, but her size keeps him from asking her to the dance.

videos.title: Cased Up
videos.overview: A pompous lawyer who's dating Hilary is no fan of Will's after he's sideswiped by Will's roadster.

videos.title: Hi-Ho Silver
videos.overview: Will and Carlton think a party guest stole the silverware.

videos.title: The Butler Did It
videos.overview: Bell Biv DeVoe shoots a video at the Bankses, courtesy of Carlton, who rents the house while his parents are away.

videos.title: Something for Nothing
videos.overview: After winning at the country club's Monte Carlo night fund-raiser, Will learns that he's expected to donate the money to charity.

videos.title: Christmas Show
videos.overview: On a family ski trip, the Banks find that they must come up with Christmas gifts from the heart after their belongings are stolen.

videos.title: Hilary Gets a Life
videos.overview: Hilary must work for a caterer after her credit cards are cancelled.

videos.title: My Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: On the basketball court, winning is everything to Will, as it is to an opponent from Malibu Prep, who can't afford to lose.

videos.title: Geoffrey Cleans Up
videos.overview: Geoffrey falls hard for a neighbor he believes is a housekeeper - but who turns out to be very wealthy.

videos.title: Community Action
videos.overview: When Hillary is ordered to do community service at a free clinic, the doctor in charge becomes the antidote for her marriage-mindedness.

videos.title: Ill Will
videos.overview: The family fears a steamy exposé when Geoffrey begins his memoirs, while Will fears the scalpel when he enters the hospital, kicking and screaming, for a tonsillectomy.

videos.title: Eyes on the Prize
videos.overview: Needing a game show partner, Will must choose between bickering friends.

videos.title: Those Were the Days
videos.overview: Philip and Vivian welcome a '60s radical, who arouses the FBI's interest and influences Will and Carlton to take action over the firing of a nonconformist teacher.

videos.title: Vying for Attention
videos.overview: Will dislikes his mother's new boyfriend.

videos.title: The Aunt Who Came to Dinner
videos.overview: Aunt Helen arrives unexpectedly, and upsets Will and Carlton's plans for a rendezvous with two French women.

videos.title: Be My Baby Tonight
videos.overview: Ashley cringes when the family oohs and aahs over her relationship with Kevin , but Will chokes when she asks him about sex - and her curiosity about reproduction sends Will to a pregnancy counseling center.

videos.title: Strip-Tease for Two
videos.overview: Will and Carlton lose their shirts investing on a tip - then take jobs as strippers to recoup their losses and get Vivian's bracelet out of hock.

videos.title: How I Spent My Summer Vacation
videos.overview: Will returns home from spending the summer in Philadelphia with a new look that doesn't sit well with Uncle Phil.

videos.title: Will Gets Committed
videos.overview: When the Banks family returns to its former neighborhood to help old friends after a destructive city-wide riot, Vivian reveals a surprise to Philip.

videos.title: That's No Lady, That's My Cousin
videos.overview: Enrolled at the newly coed Bel-Air Prep, Ashley begins dressing to entice guys, using Will's preferences in women as her examples.

videos.title: Hilary Gets a Job
videos.overview: Hilary gets a job reporting weather on television.

videos.title: Mama's Baby, Carlton's Maybe
videos.overview: Carlton prepares for a dinner date with his former girlfriend, Cindy (Lark Voorhees), forgiving her for rejecting him several months earlier, but when she arrives with a newborn baby named Carlton Jr., the entire Banks family is stunned.

videos.title: P.S. I Love You
videos.overview: While Philip entertains rude, senile Judge Robertson, Will accepts expensive gifts from Lindsey Simon, a rich classmate who wants to buy his affection.

videos.title: Here Comes the Judge
videos.overview: Will gets arrested for numerous parking tickets as Phil runs for judge against incumbent Judge Robertson.

videos.title: Boyz in the Woods
videos.overview: Philip takes Will and Carlton on a camping trip that turns out to be a disaster when snow traps the unhappy campers.

videos.title: A Night at the Oprah
videos.overview: The Bankses appear on Oprah's show and fail to invite Will on-stage, which may cause Philip to lose the election.

videos.title: Asses to Ashes
videos.overview: Election results are in and Philip fights to remain cool amid lies by Judge Robertson, which prompt Will to confront the outspoken incumbent. Will Will go to far? Will he say what everyone is feeling? Will Judge Robertson be able to take it?

videos.title: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
videos.overview: At Vivian's Lamaze class, Will cozies up to a pregnant sportswriter, who takes him to a game - and delivers more than just fun.

videos.title: The Cold War
videos.overview: When Vivian quarantines Will and Carlton in the backyard pool house after both are stricken with contagious colds, they spend the night arguing over a girl that Will stole from Carlton.

videos.title: Mommy Nearest
videos.overview: Will tries to tell his mother that he doesn't want to return to Philadelphia with her after his high school graduation.

videos.title: Winner Takes Off
videos.overview: Geoffrey humiliates himself by insulting the Banks family and quitting his job when Will and Carlton trick him into thinking he has won millions of dollars in the lottery.

videos.title: Robbing the Banks
videos.overview: Philip is quick to judge an ex-con Will urged him to hire as a handyman and temporary assistant after the house is robbed.

videos.title: Bundle of Joy
videos.overview: As Vivian's delivery date approaches, the family fantasizes about what the baby will mean to each of them: Ashley feels all but invisible, Geoffrey feels overwhelmed by the family's demands, and Vivian feels like she's having triplets.

videos.title: The Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: When Monique refuses to have sex until she's married, Will stages a mock wedding ceremony with D.J. Jazzy Jeff as the preacher.

videos.title: The Alma Matter
videos.overview: Depressed and suicidal over having ruined his chances of attending Princeton University, Carlton is visited by his Guardian Angel, who shows him how awful the Banks family would be if he weren't alive.

videos.title: Just Say Yo
videos.overview: Will learns a sobering lesson after Carlton pops the wrong pills from Will's locker, mistaking amphetamines for vitamins, and winds up in hospital.

videos.title: The Baby Comes Out
videos.overview: Vivian's baby is a week late, but family members and her visiting sisters are nowhere to be found when it's time to rush to the hospital.

videos.title: You Bet Your Life
videos.overview: Heavyweight boxing champ Riddick Brown wreaks havoc with Carlton's mind and Will's face at a funky cafe-casino in Nevada, where the cousins have stopped on their way to check out a college for Will.

videos.title: Ain't No Business Like Show Business
videos.overview: Will lands a spot in a comedy showcase after accompanying a comic friend to an audition.

videos.title: The Way We Were
videos.overview: Series clips illustrate family recollections as the kids put together a scrapbook for Vivian and Philip, who want to renew their vows on their anniversary.

videos.title: Six Degrees of Graduation
videos.overview: Vy anticipates Will's graduation with enthusiasm, but there may be discord when she learns Will is failing music. To pass his music class, Will must sing at the graduation ceremony - with a class of eight-year-olds.

videos.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way (1)
videos.overview: Will and Carlton begin their first year of college by moving into their own apartment, while Philip and Vivian enjoy their newborn son. Hilary learns that Trevor plans to propose marriage to her during an elaborate stunt on his TV news show.

videos.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way (2)
videos.overview: Will and Carlton begin their first year of college by moving into their own apartment, while Philip and Vivian enjoy their newborn son. Hilary learns that Trevor plans to propose marriage to her during an elaborate stunt on his TV news show.

videos.title: All Guts, No Glory
videos.overview: Registration day finds Will signing up for no-brainer classes, plus one that might truly challenge him - a philosophy course he takes to meet a girl.

videos.title: Father of the Year
videos.overview: Stuck with caring for Nicky for the day, Will soon discovers the benefits of baby-sitting: he's suddenly a big man on campus with the women so long as he poses as a single dad.

videos.title: It's Better to Have Loved and Lost It...
videos.overview: After Will's friends guys rib Carlton about being a virgin, Miss Right appears and sweeps Carlton off his feet. Elsewhere, Geoffrey confesses a secret of his own.

videos.title: Will Goes a-Courtin'
videos.overview: When Phillip sues Will and Carlton for unpaid rent, two different versions of the dispute are aired - neither entirely truthful.

videos.title: Hex and the Single Guy
videos.overview: Will disses a seance - until the spiritualist zaps him with a hex that (uh-oh) seems to work.

videos.title: Blood is Thicker Than Mud
videos.overview: A bro with dough? Carlton's upper-class upbringing may make him unwelcome at a black fraternity.

videos.title: Fresh Prince After Dark
videos.overview: Will breaks a date with Jackie to accompany Hilary to a Playboy Mansion reception for weather reporters being photographed for the magazine.

videos.title: Home is Where the Heart Attack Is
videos.overview: Will sneaks greasy, high-fat foods to Philip after he promises to diet and exercise, then blames himself when Philip has a heart attack.

videos.title: Take My Cousin... Please
videos.overview: On academic probation, Will schemes to improve his grades by fixing up a newly divorced English professor with Hilary, who soon finds fault with the man, further jeopardizing Will's academic future.

videos.title: You've Got to Be a Football Hero
videos.overview: Will uses booze to prove his manliness while competing with a hulking football hero who wants to score points with Jackie, and his fraternity brothers leave drunken Will in a cemetery, where he is haunted. Meanwhile, Ashley learns that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

videos.title: 'Twas the Night Before Christening
videos.overview: Vivian promises god-motherhood of her child to both of her sisters, while Will hatches a harebrained scheme to get Boyz II Men to perform at baby Nicky's christening.

videos.title: Sleepless in Bel-Air
videos.overview: Will pays for putting off studying for a midterm until the last minute, and Ashley pays for staying out late on her first date.

videos.title: Who's the Boss
videos.overview: Carlton in charge. Will gets his feathers ruffled when his cousin becomes his boss at the Peacock Stop.

videos.title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Screams
videos.overview: Bird is the word when Carlton, ULA's peacock mascot, is kidnapped by a rival school before the big game.

videos.title: When You Hit Upon a Star
videos.overview: Will becomes a jet-setter while dating a pop star.

videos.title: Stop Will! In the Name of Love
videos.overview: A Valentine's double date finds Will treating Ashley like a kid and Ashley demanding r-e-s-p-e-c-t.

videos.title: You'd Better Shop Around
videos.overview: A car dealer hires Will, then persuades him to drop out of college.

videos.title: The Ol' Ball and Chain
videos.overview: Jazz's bride has a couple of teensy character flaws: She's a convict. And she puts the moves on Will.

videos.title: The Harder They Fall
videos.overview: Will finds himself stranded in a mountain forest with his new girlfriend's disagreeable father after they parachute out of his disabled plane.

videos.title: M is for the Many Things She Gave Me
videos.overview: It's double trouble for Will when Philip's old flame visits with her daughter, who's attracted to Will.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: Say, homie, could you do me a favor? Just-married Jazz makes a surprising request of Will.

videos.title: Papa's Got a Brand-New Excuse
videos.overview: Ben Vereen plays Will's long-lost father, who breezes into town and promises Will the moon, which angers an unforgiving Philip.

videos.title: For Sale by Owner
videos.overview: A stranger makes a generous offer for the Banks estate, which prompts the family to reminisce about their good times there.

videos.title: The Philadelphia Story
videos.overview: Will returns to the City of Brotherly Love and discovers he's the butt of old friends' jokes, prompting him to go into training to settle an old score and clear his reputation as a chicken.

videos.title: The Client
videos.overview: Will revels in Ashley's music industry success, but both Will and Ashley are about to have a rude surprise.

videos.title: What's Will Got to Do With It?
videos.overview: Will helps Ashley make a big impression on a recording executive, but Philip is adamantly against her pursuing a singing career.

videos.title: Reality Bites
videos.overview: Will loses points as a role model for Nicky while visiting an ever-positive kiddie hero who brings joy to youngsters - but not to Will.

videos.title: Grumpy Young Men
videos.overview: War breaks out when the girl Will likes plants a big one on Carlton.

videos.title: Fresh Prince: The Movie
videos.overview: Will tells a tall tale about seeing a mob killing, then being placed in a witness-protection program in the backwoods of Alabama.

videos.title: Will's Misery
videos.overview: The Banks hate the ugly golf shirts Hilary gives them - until they see Kareem Abdul-Jabbar wearing the same design.

videos.title: Father Knows Best
videos.overview: To help Ashley out of a jam at school, Will poses as her father. Oh yeah, this is gonna work.

videos.title: Soooooooul Train
videos.overview: At a Soul Train reunion, middle-aged Philip feels like his train has left the station.

videos.title: Love Hurts
videos.overview: Lisa humiliates Will by knocking out a guy with her self-defense moves.

videos.title: Will's Up a Dirt Road
videos.overview: Will tries his hand at journalism to prove something to Lisa, but his efforts get him sued for libel - by Jay Leno.

videos.title: Will Steps Out
videos.overview: To understand Philip's battle with the scale, Will dons a fat suit and gets a big fat lesson in empathy.

videos.title: Same Game, Next Season
videos.overview: Will works so hard to impress Lisa's dad that he spends all his free time with his new best buddy.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: Will gets roped into a weekend ski trip with Carlton that quickly turns to disaster when their party arrives; meanwhile, back home, Hilary prepares to leave the nest.

videos.title: It's a Wonderful Lie
videos.overview: The party's over. Will and Lisa tell each other lies so they can sneak off to the (uh-oh) same party.

videos.title: Bullets Over Bel-Air
videos.overview: A planned camping trip is cut short for Carlton and Will when a robber approaches them at an automated bank-teller machine - and fires a gun.

videos.title: A Decent Proposal
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Smith? Will pops the question from his hospital room. And Lisa's answer is...

videos.title: Will is from Mars...
videos.overview: Thanks to relationship counseling, Will and Lisa hop to move on up to a new understanding in preparation for marriage. Meanwhile Hillary wants Geoffrey to work at her new home.

videos.title: The Wedding Show (Psyche!)
videos.overview: Shafted! The engaged couple opts for flashy Vegas vows, complete with costumes. The tasteful theme: Shaft.

videos.title: Slum Like It... Not!
videos.overview: Will vows Philip with his sound investment advice to buy Jazz's apartment building - but the tenants scream slumlord after Philip acts on Will's moneymaking tip.

videos.title: As the Will Turns
videos.overview: Will inadvertently finds himself in the right place at the right time and lands a part in a daytime soap opera.

videos.title: Save the Last Trance for Me
videos.overview: Put into a trance by a stage hypnotist, Will behaves like a 4-year-old just as the family gears up for an interview with the admissions head of a private school.

videos.title: To Thine Own Self Be Blue... and Gold
videos.overview: A dream job for Will with a businessman friend of Philip's turns into a nightmare when the man offers him a bonus to help bribe a councilman.

videos.title: Cold Feet, Hot Body
videos.overview: Dinner date. The Banks host a gorgeous girl from Philly who tries to lure Will away from Lisa.

videos.title: Love in an Elevator
videos.overview: Stuck and out of luck, Will spends his bachelor party trapped in an elevator with a feuding Carlton and Jazz.

videos.title: For Whom the Wedding Bells Toll
videos.overview: Husband-to-be Will has the bride, the ring, the date...and second thoughts about the whole idea.

videos.title: Burnin' Down the House
videos.overview: While Carlton is away at a Young Republican camp, Will cooks up a flambe of a disaster on a night when an influential judge is coming to dinner, and Will can only make it through the night with the help of Geoffrey, and other plan is not to make Phil find out.

videos.title: Get a Job
videos.overview: In competition with Carlton, Will sets out to prove he's the best man for the job on Hilary's TV show by escorting a famous comedian's sister out on the town.

videos.title: Stress Related
videos.overview: After learning a little something about initiative, Will jumps to Hilary's aid prior to a key business meeting at the station, meanwhile an unemployed Carlton subs for Philip on career day at Ashley's school.

videos.title: Bourgie Sings the Blues
videos.overview: The thrill is gone for "runaway yuppie" Carlton, who can't handle another disappointment, let alone his long-awaited Princeton interview.

videos.title: The Script Formerly Known As...
videos.overview: Will decides to book a juror dismissed from Philip's big show-biz madam sex-scandal case for Hilary's show, which results in embarrassment for Judge Banks and some annoying apologies from Will and Hilary.

videos.title: Not, I Barbecue
videos.overview: Will and Carlton's double date ends unromantically when a big bruiser shows up looking for his squeeze.

videos.title: Not With My Cousin You Don't
videos.overview: Freakin' out! On the home intercom, Will and Carlton overhear Ashley talking about sex.

videos.title: Viva Lost Wages
videos.overview: Carlton is on a roll in Vegas, celebrating his birthday at the gaming tables with Will in tow but suddenly the tables turn, and the duo enter a dance contest to recoup their losses.

videos.title: There's the Rub (1)
videos.overview: Hilary and Carlton volunteer at a homeless shelter on Thanksgiving, while the extended family fills up on holiday treats.

videos.title: There's the Rub (2)
videos.overview: Will and Philip are arrested at a massage parlor on Thanksgiving. Hilary and Carlton get a lesson in humility at the homeless shelter.

videos.title: I, Ooh, Baby, Baby
videos.overview: Hilary's show has its national premiere. What more could she possibly want? How about a baby?

videos.title: Boxing Helena
videos.overview: Will's pride is on the ropes when a gorgeous boxing instructor KOs him at the gym.

videos.title: I, Clownius
videos.overview: It's no laughing matter when a bomb-toting clown holds Philip hostage in the courtroom on the day of the showbiz madam's sentencing.

videos.title: Breaking Up is Hard To Do (1)
videos.overview: Ka-boooom! That explosion you hear is Philip and Vivian's marriage after Philip decides to go into politics.

videos.title: Breaking Up is Hard To Do (2)
videos.overview: Breaking up may not be so hard to do for an angry Vivian, but when Philip finds he's lost without her, Will and Carlton conspire to reunite them.

videos.title: I, Bowl Buster
videos.overview: After being accepted at Princeton, a worried Carlton changes his life plans and retreats to a place where everybody knows his name - the bowling alley.

videos.title: The Butler's Son Did It
videos.overview: Geoffrey's life changes overnight when a man claiming to be his long-lost son shows up and charms everyone - except Will, who discovers the guy's not what he seems. Meanwhile, Hilary starts writing her autobiography, and an early childhood photo reveals a shocking secret.

videos.title: Hare Today...
videos.overview: The church's widowed reverend is a man of esteemed reputation, but not in the eyes of Will - who spies him making a play for Aunt Vivian.

videos.title: I, Whoops, There It Is
videos.overview: Dick Clark has a cameo on this backstage outing that has Will Smith visiting with series stars and screening series bloopers.

videos.title: I, Stank Horse
videos.overview: Philip expects Ashley to decline an offer for what he considers a degrading role in an ad by a director who could also give her a recommendation to a top New York school.

videos.title: I, Stank Hole in One
videos.overview: On Live with Regis and Kathie Lee, Hilary subs for Gifford but doesn't see eye-to-eye with co-host Philbin. Meanwhile, Will subs for Carlton in a golf tourney and gets buddy-buddy with Philip, making Carlton jealous.

videos.title: Eye, Tooth
videos.overview: William Shatner stars as Hilary's talk-show guest, but Will must find a way to beam him from the dentist's chair to the set. Meanwhile, Hilary's show treks to New York and Ashley insists on tagging along.

videos.title: I, Done (1)
videos.overview: The mansion's for sale and everybody's in the fast lane... except Will, who's stuck on life's soft shoulder.

videos.title: I, Done (2)
videos.overview: The Banks move out. The Jeffersons are about to move in. And Will turns out the lights.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 16 wins & 32 nominations total
